photos.desc: He seems terrified. They are just so quiet. Perhaps we were the afternoons entertainment?
Must be parrot season? A pair of red shouldered's waiting to feed on the grass seed below
Male red shouldered parrot eating mistletoe fruit. The group was hard to spot at times, they blend in well, and often deed inside the clump of mistletoe. They always arrived late in the evening
A Red-winged Parrot in the Dunedin Botanic Gardens aviary, New Zealand.
